title: Sportswear HO19 / Zoom 2K repeated shoe collage

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Use repetition and rotation to make a static product image feel active while keeping the shoe recognizable.
strategic_value: The five white shoe cutouts can give Zoom 2K an energetic visual rhythm without requiring a new photographic scene.
demonstration: Five shoe cutouts fan upward across a grainy, folded-paper background within a pale border.
practical_value: Compare how repeated silhouettes create direction and depth in a single still image.

content_islands.name: Repeated footwear
content_islands.spec: Arrange five overlapping shoe views from the large lower foreground toward the upper background.

content_islands.name: Textured field
content_islands.spec: Keep the distressed gray paper texture behind the cutouts and a pale border around the composition.

reference_purposes.Expression: Five shoe cutouts fan upward across a grainy, folded-paper background within a pale border.
